note: One page per pure-CSS text effect: /effects/<name>/ (99; e.g. /effects/typewriter-effect/ = 'Typewriter Text Effect — Pure CSS, Free Code', /effects/glitch-text-effect/). Every page is a text effect, so the element is fixed. The eight root pages (/css-glitch-text-effects/ …) are kind listings that link the effects, not effects themselves; they are one segment deep so they never match.
